title: Prove KP animation picker protocol conformance

sourceRefs.summary: KP grouped animation picker model and renderer boundary.
KP-owned adapter from grouped animation descriptors to renderer-neutral picker state, navigation commands, and tagged selection intents.

verificationRecords.notes: Four tests pass, including renderer-neutral stable-identity projection over 45 grouped animation descriptors.
Application, Node, test, and domain TypeScript projects pass from the isolated worktree using KP's existing dependency tree.

progress.summary: KP now adapts its existing grouped animation picker to a local renderer-neutral snapshot with stable descriptor identity, cursor projection, clamped navigation commands, and tagged selection intents carrying surface/provider/query provenance; conformance cases remain to be pinned.

expectedLearning: Whether KP can consume the language-neutral Spindle picker state and intent boundary without depending on Spindle implementation code.
allowedWork: Bounded KP animation picker model, renderer adapter, protocol conformance tests, and owner-local Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: No Spindle dependency, no picker framework, no fuzzy-scoring policy, no visual redesign, and no unrelated concept-room work.
